# King Gillette — self-test quiz demo
qa = [
    ("What is King Gillette known for?", "safety razor"),
    ("What field did King Gillette work in?", "shaving"),

    ("What is field?", "shaving"),
    ("What is known for?", "safety razor"),
    ("What is note?", "Disposable blades built an empire"),
]

    print(f"Q{i}: {q}")
    ans = input("Your answer: ").strip().lower()
    if ans and ans in a.lower():
        print("Correct.")
        score += 1

        print(f"Answer: {a}")
